name: fd-smart-case-inline-flags
prompt: Bug: an inline case-insensitive flag breaks smart case for the other patterns. With files foo-bar, foo-BAR and FOO-BAR, `fd foo --and bar` lists all three (smart case: all lowercase means case-insensitive), but `fd '(?i)foo' --and bar` lists only foo-bar, as if the (?i) made the search case-sensitive. Same with `fd foo --and '(?i)bar'` and `(?i:foo)`. Expected: smart case looks at the literal characters a pattern contains; an inline (?i) must not count as uppercase. --ignore-case and --case-sensitive keep overriding smart case, and a pattern with a real uppercase letter outside the flag (e.g. `(?i)Foo`) is still case-sensitive as before.
